# Arvexo Radar

> Arvexo Radar is a service for analyzing prompts sent to AI agents. It classifies use cases, measures effectiveness and ROI, and turns proven scenarios into company-wide best practices.

Arvexo Radar (Russian: «Аналитика промптов и эффективности ИИ») is part of the Arvexo AI ecosystem: https://arvexo.ru

## Capabilities

- Classification of requests to AI agents by scenario and business function
- Discovery of repeatable, high-value usage scenarios
- Effectiveness, time-saved and ROI measurement
- Verified AI best practices that can be published and scaled

## Pages

- [Arvexo Radar landing (Russian)](https://radar.arvexo.ru/): product overview, platform, scenarios
- [Arvexo research](https://arvexo.ru/ru/research): latest research notes from the Arvexo team
